sub_sector.value: smart metering and grid-edge intelligence for utilities; utility software and services

manufacturing_type.detail: Assembles smart meters, communication modules and edge devices, partly via contract manufacturers; also software.

production_model.detail: Standard meter and device platforms built to utility contract orders and deployment schedules.

product_complexity.detail: Intelligent networked meters, devices and software configured for utility deployments.

production_role.detail: Sells finished meters, networks, software and services directly to utilities and cities.

end_market_exposure.detail: Electric, gas and water utilities and cities buying metering, grid-edge and smart city solutions.

notes: Manufacturing details and production model come from general knowledge; the evidence mostly describes solutions and locations.
